reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so this hits a real problem, and the lab report on the box plus the money-back guarantee make one box at $24.99 feel low risk. I would only do the first box at the launch price.
objection: $29.99 a month is a lot on my budget, and 30 foil sachets feel like more packaging waste than a normal bottle.
would_change_my_mind: A regular price closer to $20, or a bottle option so there is less packaging.
